annotations.title: A document snapshot by version or date

description: One observed snapshot: by version number, or the one LexAPI held at the end of a date (YYYY-MM-DD), with observedFrom / observedUntil. LexAPI's fetch history, NOT the law in force on that date (lex_legislation_as_of gives the version of an EU act for a date). A date before the document entered the corpus is a 404 (before_tracking); one LexAPI cannot place is a 404 (boundary_unknown) listing the candidate versions, refunded. Cost: 1 credit.

date.description: Return the snapshot current on this date (YYYY-MM-DD, end of day UTC).

include.description: Only these parts. "paragraphs" = judgment grounds / text of documents without articles.

language.description: Language: ISO 639-1 code of an official EU language (en, fr, de, …; default en).

offset.description: Continue after a truncated response (value given in its note).

view.description: auto: the body if it fits maxChars, else an outline. full: body up to maxChars, then offset to continue.
